'''Fredrik Hagen''' was a Khalindarian general involved in the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]]. He represented Khalindar's military interests during negotiations with Solara.

== Conference Role ==

Hagen assessed how Khalindar's forces could be used against the [[Vesperan Empire]] and what support Khalindar would require to sustain the commitment. He helped define military aid, training, intelligence cooperation, and logistics expectations in the Solaran offer.

== Legacy ==

Hagen's role linked the conference's diplomatic promises to practical military planning. Khalindarian later claims treated the promised military and logistical support as part of the broader settlement Solara failed to honor after the [[Avant Great War]].
